name: @bridge/integrations-canvas
description: Canvas LMS integration — the EGRESS adapter (Canvas REST v1 over @bridge/net-guard's guardedFetch, the only file that touches a Canvas instance), an access-token paste-and-validate flow (Canvas Account → Settings → New Access Token; no OAuth app registration for a single-user connector), and pure intake mapping into Academics Subject/Assignment rows. Read-only: no external:send capability.
